problems.title: Last Stone Weight
problems.notes: single max-heap warm-up before graduating to problems that need two heaps at once

problems.title: K Closest Points to Origin
problems.notes: max-heap of size k, or quickselect for O(n) average — know both, quickselect is the standard follow-up

problems.title: Ugly Number II
problems.notes: min-heap generating candidates in order, or a 3-pointer DP — the DP version avoids heap overhead entirely

problems.title: Reorganize String
problems.notes: max-heap by frequency: always place the most frequent remaining char that isn't the previous one placed

problems.title: Find Median from Data Stream
problems.notes: the canonical two-heaps problem: max-heap for the lower half, min-heap for the upper half, rebalance to keep sizes within 1

problems.title: Sliding Window Median
problems.notes: two heaps + lazy deletion, since a heap can't cheaply remove an arbitrary element as the window slides

problems.title: IPO
problems.notes: greedy + two heaps: a min-heap of projects by required capital (unlocking) and a max-heap by profit (among affordable)

problems.title: Course Schedule III
problems.notes: greedy + max-heap: take courses sorted by deadline, evict the longest-duration one already taken if you overshoot
